definitions.explanation: The last act of a play or performance. Also used figuratively for the conclusion or final stage of an event, era, or situation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{物語|ものがたり}→物語：03634_monogatari⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{終幕|しゅうまく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{迎|むか}えた→迎える：01193_mukaeru⟧。

{終幕|しゅうまく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{主人公|しゅじんこう}→主人公：11404_shujinkou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{死|し}ぬ→死ぬ：00669_shinu⟧⟦{場面|ばめん}→場面：03702_bamen⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{観客|かんきゃく}→観客：02556_kankyaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{泣|な}かせた→泣く：00655_naku⟧。
examples.english: The scene where the protagonist dies in the final act moved the audience to tears.

examples.japanese: ⟦{長|なが}く→長い：00491_nagai⟧⟦{続|つづ}いた→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧⟦{交渉|こうしょう}→交渉：02727_koushou⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧、ようやく{終幕|しゅうまく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{迎|むか}えよう→迎える：01193_mukaeru⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: The long-running negotiations are finally approaching their conclusion.

notes:
A compound of {終|しゅう} (end) and ⟦{幕|まく}→幕：12518_maku⟧ (curtain, act). Originally a theater term for the final act of a play, now commonly used figuratively for the conclusion of any extended event or situation.

USAGE:
The phrase {終幕|しゅうまく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{迎|むか}える→迎える：01193_mukaeru⟧ (to reach the final act/conclusion) is the most common pattern. Has a dramatic, literary tone compared to plain words like ⟦{終|お}わり→終わり：01361_owari⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {終幕|しゅうまく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{迎|むか}える→迎える：01193_mukaeru⟧ — to reach the finale
- {終幕|しゅうまく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飾|かざ}る→飾る：01185_kazaru⟧ — to grace the finale
- {大|だい}{団円|だんえん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{終幕|しゅうまく} — a happy ending

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{開幕|かいまく}→開幕：08174_kaimaku⟧ — opening (act), beginning (opposite)
- ⟦{幕切|まくぎ}れ→幕切れ：15238_makugire⟧ — end of an act, conclusion (more sudden nuance)
- ⟦{大詰|おおづ}め→大詰め：19935_oozume⟧ — climax, final stage
- フィナーレ — finale (loanword)
